name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill, 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester), since 1952
Happy hour is 3-6 daily
Mon: half off burgers 11-3
Tue: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos, $6 margaritas (tacos 11 AM to midnight)
Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3
Fri: $3 sliders 11-3
Every week: karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs
Joining Melody Rewards is free and gives 100 welcome points
10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip
Birthday bonus: +250 points once a year
Refer a friend: +100 points when they join with your code and make a first visit
Rewards: 250 pts soft drink or Melody Fries, 500 pts $10 off, 1,000 pts free starter, 1,500 pts free entrée
One reward per visit, one prize per day, no stacking, never free alcohol
Reward passes work once and expire 10 minutes after you open them
Just Landed: 10% off your first order with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours
Melody Approach: flying game, Campaign (10 levels) and Survival modes
Weekly boards reset every Monday; game prizes are BETA and not on yet
Once game rewards are on: 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day
Games Pack: Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word, Melody Mix, Truth or Dare
Order from your phone: pick table, bar, patio or to go; pay your server as usual
No app download: opens in your phone browser and can be added to your home screen
Free parking, per the restaurant's website
About a 15-minute walk from LAX
Location bonus: +100 points once for opening the app with location and notifications on across 3 different days within 7 days
App has 12 languages

How do I order from my table?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: The restaurant's website lists Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late night.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: The website lists 1:30 AM every night, but hours can vary. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.

qa.q: What time do you open on weekends?
qa.a: The website lists 9 AM on Saturday and Sunday. Call (310) 670-1994 if you want to double-check.

qa.q: When does the kitchen close?
qa.a: I don't have the kitchen close time. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994 before you come late.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: Melody is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045, in Westchester. The Directions button in the app opens the map.

qa.q: How close are you to LAX?
qa.a: Melody is about 5 minutes from LAX. Walking from the terminals takes about 15 minutes.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: Per the restaurant's website, parking is free, including a free lot for people picking up travelers. Ask staff if you're unsure where to park.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: Call (310) 670-1994, or tap the Call button in the app.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap Directions in the Visit Melody section of the app to open the map.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have reservation details. Call (310) 670-1994 to ask.

qa.q: When is happy hour?
qa.a: Happy hour is 3 to 6 every day.

qa.q: What are the drink prices at happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have the happy hour drink prices. Ask your server or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: What are today's specials?
qa.a: Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3. Happy hour is 3-6 daily.

qa.q: What is the Monday special?
qa.a: Half off burgers from 11 to 3.

qa.q: Do you have Taco Tuesday?
qa.a: Yes. Classic tacos are $4 each and elevated tacos are $6.99 each, 11 AM to midnight on Tuesdays. Margaritas are $6 on Tuesdays.

qa.q: What are the elevated tacos?
qa.a: The Baja Shrimp Taco Melt, the Smash Burger Taco and the Sweet & Spicy Fried Chicken Taco, $6.99 each on Tuesdays.

qa.q: What are the classic tacos on Tuesday?
qa.a: Chicken, Steak, Carnitas, Dockside Fish, Shrimp, Salmon, Avocado, Beyond and Vegan Carnitas, $4 each.

qa.q: Is the Taco Tuesday menu available on other days?
qa.a: The app shows it every day, but you can only add it to your order on Tuesdays.

qa.q: What is the Thursday special?
qa.a: Half off sandwiches from 11 to 3.

qa.q: What is the Friday special?
qa.a: $3 sliders from 11 to 3.

qa.q: What is the Wednesday special?
qa.a: The app doesn't list a Wednesday food special. Karaoke is part of the weekly lineup, so ask staff or call (310) 670-1994 for Wednesday details.

qa.q: Do you have karaoke?
qa.a: Yes, karaoke is part of Melody's weekly lineup. I don't have the exact night and time in the app, so ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you have live music or DJs?
qa.a: Yes. Every week Melody has karaoke, live bands, DJs and trivia, and every game is on the TVs. Call (310) 670-1994 for the schedule.

qa.q: Can I watch the game at Melody?
qa.a: Yes, every game is on the TVs. The Sports tab in the app shows today's LA and California team games and where to watch.

qa.q: Is there a cover charge?
qa.a: I don't have cover charge details for events. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Tap Join in the app. It's free, takes about 10 seconds, and you get 100 welcome points.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No, joining is free. It's one account per person.

qa.q: Do I need to download an app?
qa.a: No download. It opens in your phone's browser. Use the link on Instagram @melodylax or scan the QR code on your table.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my home screen?
qa.a: Open it in your phone's browser and use the browser's Add to Home Screen option. On iPhone, notifications need the app on your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or newer).

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip. You also get bonus points for joining, your birthday, referrals and more.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get my points after I eat?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app and snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). It's automatic once Melody connects its register system.

qa.q: Is there a limit on adding visits?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check only once, and up to $150 per check. Points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do I earn points on drinks and food?
qa.a: Yes. You earn points on every check. Ask staff if you're not sure whether something is eligible, since the eligible list isn't final.

qa.q: Do I earn points when I order from my phone?
qa.a: Yes. Pay your server or bartender like normal and you still earn points on every check.

qa.q: How many welcome points do I get?
qa.a: 100 points once when you join.

qa.q: What is the birthday bonus?
qa.a: You get +250 points once a year on your birthday.

qa.q: How does the referral program work?
qa.a: Tap Text a friend on your member card to send your invite link. Your friend joins with your code and comes in. You get +100 points, and they get 100 welcome points too.

qa.q: When do I get my referral points?
qa.a: Referral points pay once per friend, after their first visit.

qa.q: Can I use my own referral code?
qa.a: No. You can enter one friend's code, once, when you join. It can't be changed later.

qa.q: What is the Location buddy bonus?
qa.a: It's a one-time +100 points. Turn on nearby alerts, then open the app with location and notifications on across at least 3 different days within a 7-day span. It's added automatically.

qa.q: Is there an early-bird bonus?
qa.a: The app doesn't list an early-bird bonus. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you have levels or tiers?
qa.a: The app doesn't show levels or tiers. You earn points and spend them on the rewards.

qa.q: Is there a review bonus?
qa.a: Yes, the app is set to give +50 points once per member for telling Melody how we did.

qa.q: What rewards can I get?
qa.a: 250 pts: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500 pts: $10 off your check. 1,000 pts: free starter. 1,500 pts: free entrée.

qa.q: What does the 250-point reward get me?
qa.a: A free soft drink or Melody Fries.

qa.q: What does the 500-point reward get me?
qa.a: $10 off your check.

qa.q: What does the 1,000-point reward get me?
qa.a: A free starter: Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers.

qa.q: What does the 1,500-point reward get me?
qa.a: A free meal: any entrée up to $21.50, such as Mac & Cheese, the Melody Burger, a burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: It works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it. A used or expired code never works again.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day (Los Angeles date). A second one shows Come back tomorrow. Rewards can't be stacked.

qa.q: Can I get free alcohol with points?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have expiry details. Points you've earned stay in your balance unless the program ends. Ask staff for specifics.

qa.q: Can I give my points to someone else?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: What is Just Landed?
qa.a: If you just got off a flight, show your boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours. You get 10% off your first order today.

qa.q: Are there limits on Just Landed?
qa.a: One per guest per day, and it can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: Do you have an LAX employee discount?
qa.a: The restaurant's website lists 10% off the check for airline, TSA, terminal, hotel, rental car and shuttle workers with a badge, dine-in only. Ask staff to confirm.

qa.q: What is Melody Approach?
qa.a: A free arcade flying game. Fly over a real SoCal route in Campaign (10 levels), or see how long you can last in Survival.

qa.q: How do I control the plane?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap the ⚡ button for a speed boost.

qa.q: How does Campaign mode work?
qa.a: It has 10 levels of about 45 seconds, each a little harder, with six boss fights. You fly from LAX through Hollywood, Venice, Inglewood, Compton and Long Beach, then land back at LAX.

qa.q: How does Survival mode work?
qa.a: There's no finish line and it keeps getting harder. Your time survived is your score.

qa.q: How do I lose or die in the game?
qa.a: You have 100% health. Three hits and your plane goes down, and the game is over. Enemy attacks are warned first.

qa.q: What are the power-ups in the game?
qa.a: Catch Melody's food and music notes for points. Grab the hourglass for slow-mo and ammo crates to refill your guns.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses, or flying longer in Survival, unlocks stronger guns.

qa.q: Can I play without combat?
qa.a: Yes. Pause and turn combat off, or tap the ⚔️ button, for a calm flight.

qa.q: How often can I play the game?
qa.a: It's free to play, with or without an account, and the app shows no play limit. Only game points have a daily cap.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There are two boards: Campaign (ranked by score) and Survival (ranked by longest time). Both reset every Monday. Tap Post my score after a flight. Practice and test flights don't count.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: Game prizes are in BETA and switched off right now, so the boards are for bragging rights. When they turn on, the top player on each board may win the weekly prize shown in the game, currently Free Melody Fries.

qa.q: When are the weekly prizes picked?
qa.a: The boards reset every Monday. I don't have the details on when winners are picked or how they're contacted. Ask staff.

qa.q: Do I earn points from the flying game?
qa.a: Not yet. Game rewards are off during the BETA. When they switch on, you earn 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day.

qa.q: Can I cheat on the leaderboard?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: What is Melody Games?
qa.a: A pack of Trivia, Sports Trivia, Truth or Dare, the daily Melody Word and Melody Mix. Play solo or pass the phone around the table.

qa.q: How does Trivia work?
qa.a: Pick a category, answer each question before the timer runs out, and faster right answers score more. Play solo for 10 questions or pass the phone with 2-6 players.

qa.q: What is Sports Trivia?
qa.a: Trivia about LA and other sports. You can pick your team for a 10-question Fan Test and get a Fan Rating, or play all LA sports.

qa.q: What is Melody Word?
qa.a: One daily 5-letter word, the same for everyone that day. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints. A new word comes every day at midnight LA time.

qa.q: What is Melody Mix?
qa.a: A word-scramble game. Unscramble as many words as you can against the timer. You get 3 skips.

qa.q: What is Truth or Dare?
qa.a: A table game for 1-6 players with light questions and fun dares. It's just for fun with no points. Dares never involve drinking and anyone can pass.

qa.q: Do the trivia games earn points?
qa.a: Not yet, since game rewards are off in the BETA. When they turn on: Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers (max 5 a round), Melody Mix 1 per 2 words (max 3), and Melody Word 3 points (2 with 1 hint, 1 with 2 hints). The Games Pack cap is 10 points a day.

qa.q: What is the 'Who wins?' pick?
qa.a: A free, just-for-fun pick on LA games with no money or wagers. Once game rewards are on, a right pick made before the game starts earns 2 points, up to 6 a day. Picks lock when the game starts.

qa.q: Do you have Football Squares?
qa.a: The rules describe free Football Squares boards. Members get 1 free square per game by tapping Get my free square, and staff can add extra squares with a purchase. Prizes are shown on each board.

qa.q: Can I order from my table?
qa.a: Yes. Scan your table's QR code and your table is already picked, or choose Bar, Patio or To go. Add items and tap Send my order.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: Pay your server or bartender like normal. You still earn points on every check.

qa.q: Can I order to go?
qa.a: Yes. Choose To go in the app when you pick your spot.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Starters, Mac & Cheese, burgers, fries, soups, tacos and burritos, plus Taco Tuesday items and a full drinks list. Browse it in the Menu tab.

qa.q: What Mac & Cheese do you have?
qa.a: House Mac, Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeño, Parmesan & Mushroom, Chicken Parmesan, Melody Burger Mac and Lobster Mac & Cheese.

qa.q: What starters do you have?
qa.a: Lemon Pepper Wings, Avocado Toast, BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites, Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries, Chicken Pot Stickers, Fried Green Beans, Fried Shrimp, Jalapeño Calamari, Lettuce Wraps and Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: Do you have vegan or vegetarian options?
qa.a: The app has Avocado Tacos, Beyond Tacos, Vegan Carnitas Tacos on Tuesdays, Avocado Toast, Fried Green Beans and a Parmesan & Mushroom Mac. Ask staff about ingredients.

qa.q: How much is the Melody Burger?
qa.a: $19.25. It's grilled Angus beef on a pretzel bun with fries.

qa.q: How much are the Melody Fries?
qa.a: $5.75. They're shoestring fries with sea salt and pepper, and you can add cheese for $2.

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: Mango and House Margaritas, Paloma, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, draft beer, Mimosa, shots and a bucket of beers. Drink prices in the app are previews, so ask staff for current prices.

qa.q: How much is a margarita?
qa.a: House Margaritas are $6 on Tuesdays. Other days, drink prices in the app are previews, so ask your server.

qa.q: Is there breakfast or brunch?
qa.a: The restaurant's website lists weekend brunch from 9 AM to 3 PM and a weekday breakfast menu 11 AM to 2 PM. The app doesn't show a breakfast menu, so call to confirm.

qa.q: Is Melody kid friendly?
qa.a: I don't have the evening or late-night age policy. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994. In the app, a kid mode hides adult-only game content.

qa.q: What is kid mode in the games?
qa.a: When kid mode is on, the Games section hides the adult-only games. Dares in Truth or Dare never involve drinking.

qa.q: Do you have private events or catering?
qa.a: The restaurant's website lists private parties (10-150 guests) and catering. Call (310) 670-1994 to ask.

qa.q: Do you deliver?
qa.a: The restaurant's website lists DoorDash delivery and takeout. Call (310) 670-1994 for details.

qa.q: What languages is the app in?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages.

qa.q: Can I put my rewards card in Apple or Google Wallet?
qa.a: Not yet. You get a gold Melody Rewards card in the app on your phone. Wallet buttons aren't on yet.

qa.q: Where do I find my rewards card?
qa.a: After you join, tap My Rewards Card in the app. It shows your card ID, points, next reward and a QR code.

qa.q: Is my location tracked?
qa.a: No. Nearby alerts are optional and only work while the app is open on your screen. Your location is never sold or shared and isn't used for ads. You can turn it off in the app or your phone Settings.

qa.q: What does the app record about me?
qa.a: When you open the app (at most once every 10 minutes), it records the time, a short device summary and a random phone ID. It also records your member ID if you joined. It's used for rewards limits, fraud prevention and visit stats, seen only by the restaurant and SousShift AI, and never sold.

qa.q: Who can I ask for help?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: My points or reward isn't showing. What do I do?
qa.a: Show your server the app. If points are missing, check that you added the visit with your receipt (one per day, once per check). Otherwise ask staff for help.
